_readme: This file is the content source for every case study on the site.
Add, edit or delete a project here, run `node build.js`, and the work/ pages,
the portfolio grid and the home-page rail all follow. Nothing else to touch.
Required on every project: slug, service, client, industry, headline,
statement, card. Everything else is optional — a section whose data is
missing is dropped from the page rather than rendered empty.
All projects and facts here are verified against the official project data and documentation.

projects.headline: Modernising Heritage Ayurveda for Digital D2C Commerce
projects.statement: Responsive Shopify architecture, authentic botanical storytelling, and conversion-focused product pages bringing a 1945 legacy Ayurvedic brand into modern digital retail.

card.blurb: Responsive Shopify storefront honouring 1945 Ayurvedic heritage with benefit-first product hierarchy.

hero.label: Shopify Storefront — Desktop & Mobile
hero.caption: Heritage botanical aesthetics paired with conversion-led product pages.

challenge.title: A legacy healing tradition lost in modern e-commerce complexity
challenge.lead: Aarshaveda carries generational formulation expertise dating to 1945, but modern digital shoppers found traditional Ayurvedic catalog presentations intimidating and fragmented.
points: Dense Sanskrit terminology and clinical descriptions overwhelmed buyers looking for accessible daily botanical wellness.
Customers required immediate clarity on pure ingredients, safety certifications, and therapeutic benefits before purchasing premium baby care and wellness formulations.
Mobile visitors accounted for majority of discovery traffic but faced navigation friction on legacy layouts.
challenge.objective: Redesign and engineer a high-converting Shopify storefront that preserves heritage authenticity while delivering effortless modern shopping.

strategy.title: Heritage meets purity: an editorial wellness experience
strategy.lead: We developed an organic visual design system and restructured product storytelling around personal wellness routines rather than botanical textbooks.
principles: Earthy organic palette paired with clean editorial typography
Benefit-first product detail hierarchy with visible ingredient provenance
Adaptive responsive viewports with sticky mobile checkout triggers
Transparent quality standards and AYUSH certifications highlighted at decision points

decisions.title: Ingredient transparency and benefit-led hero blocks
decisions.body: Every product page opens with primary therapeutic benefits, followed by illustrated ingredient breakdowns and clinical certifications before pricing.
decisions.why: Wellness buyers make decisions based on ingredient safety and purity. Leading with botanical provenance builds immediate buying confidence.

decisions.title: Curated wellness routines replacing isolated SKUs
decisions.body: Grouped complementary treatments into morning rituals, baby care routines, and restorative regimens with single-click bundle additions.
decisions.why: Encourages regimen-based healing while increasing average order value naturally without aggressive sales banners.

decisions.title: Zero-friction mobile checkout architecture
decisions.body: Integrated persistent sticky cart actions, instant pincode delivery checks, and multi-gateway express payments.
decisions.why: Removes checkout hesitation on mobile devices where over 70% of initial wellness discovery occurs.

designSystem.title: Botanical design language built for scale
designSystem.lead: A bespoke visual identity balancing traditional Ayurvedic warmth with modern digital accessibility.

items.v: Warm serif display headings paired with high-legibility geometric sans-serif body
Earthy botanical sage, warm terracotta accents, and soft cream surfaces
Modular Shopify sections for ingredients, customer verification, and routines
Fluid layouts optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports

implementation.title: Lightweight Shopify theme engineering
implementation.lead: Engineered clean liquid templates stripped of unneeded third-party scripts to guarantee sub-2s mobile loading.
points: Custom modular Liquid sections manageable directly by the in-house merchandising team
Fast responsive image delivery pipeline optimized for 4G mobile connections
Full catalog categorization by health goal (Baby Care, Immunity, Daily Vitality)
Native Shopify review integration and trust badge certification framework

projects.resultsNote: Deployed on production Shopify architecture with fully verified mobile responsiveness and modular content controls.
projects.takeaway: Honouring heritage authenticity builds deeper commercial trust than copying generic direct-to-consumer fads. Structuring product pages around clear wellness concerns gave customers the confidence to buy.

projects.headline: Serene Visual Identity & Booking Architecture for Luxury Retreats
projects.statement: A calm, immersive digital experience designed to translate holistic healing sanctuary experiences into direct retreat reservations.

card.blurb: Serene visual identity and friction-free inquiry architecture for a holistic wellness sanctuary in Kerala.

hero.label: Sacred Lotus Sanctuary — Desktop Experience
hero.caption: Immersive photography and tranquil editorial pacing designed to convey retreat peace.

challenge.title: A transformative retreat with an uninspired digital presence
challenge.lead: Sacred Lotus offers world-class holistic healing, yoga, and Ayurvedic therapies, yet their original website failed to evoke the sanctuary atmosphere or guide prospective guests to book.
points: Prospective wellness travelers could not easily understand retreat program daily schedules, accommodations, or dietary plans.
Inquiry forms were generic, requiring long email exchanges just to qualify guest dates and wellness goals.
Visual assets felt disconnected from the natural beauty and mindfulness of the physical location.
challenge.objective: Build a tranquil, high-converting digital presence that conveys retreat serenity while guiding international and domestic travelers smoothly toward reservations.

strategy.title: Tranquil pacing and purpose-driven retreat pathways
strategy.lead: We structured the experience around guest intent, letting visitors explore specific healing programs (Detox, Rejuvenation, Yoga) with transparent itineraries and effortless consultation booking.
principles: Warm, spacious editorial layout reflecting mindful retreat calm
Program-first exploration detailing daily schedules, meals, and accommodations
Structured consultation brief filtering guest dates and health requirements
High-resolution visual galleries capturing lush Kerala sanctuary landscapes

decisions.title: Program-first discovery architecture
decisions.body: Replaced vague package lists with detailed program overviews featuring daily schedules, therapies included, and practitioner bios.
decisions.why: Retreat seekers invest in specific health and mental outcomes; showing the full daily journey builds deep emotional alignment.

decisions.title: Interactive accommodation showcase
decisions.body: Designed dedicated photo tours and amenity breakdowns for each villa and eco-cottage category.
decisions.why: Accommodations are the primary physical comfort consideration; clarity here reduces hesitation for high-ticket bookings.

decisions.title: Holistic inquiry brief replacing generic contact forms
decisions.body: Introduced an inquiry workflow gathering target retreat dates, wellness focus, and dietary preferences.
decisions.why: Gives the retreat team a fully qualified guest profile for personalized follow-up calls.

designSystem.title: Mindful sanctuary aesthetics
designSystem.lead: Calming aesthetics designed to slow the visitor down and reflect Ayurvedic mindfulness.

items.v: Elegant high-contrast serif headlines with generous line-height sans-serif copy
Muted lotus pink accents, deep forest greens, and warm linen canvas
Gentle fade transitions and spacious content rhythm
Full-bleed atmospheric sanctuary imagery and natural textures

implementation.title: Bespoke WordPress & Figma implementation
implementation.lead: Prototyped end-to-end in Figma and developed as a responsive WordPress installation with seamless inquiry routing.
points: Custom lightweight WordPress page architecture with zero visual page builder bloat
Inquiry capture routed directly to guest relations management
Optimized media pipeline delivering high-definition retreat imagery with fast mobile delivery
Comprehensive mobile viewport adaptation for international guests booking on mobile

projects.resultsNote: Delivered complete responsive CMS and design system with structured guest intake workflows.
projects.takeaway: For luxury wellness retreats, web design must embody the psychological benefit of the experience. Designing for tranquility while structuring the inquiry path turns daydreamers into booked guests.

projects.headline: Clinical Credibility & Consultation Experience for Anti-Aging Science
projects.statement: A precision-crafted digital presence for a premier Mumbai anti-aging clinic, turning complex dermatological science into trusted client bookings.

card.blurb: Modern clinical elegance and structured consultation funnels for an advanced anti-aging practice.

hero.label: DeAge Clinic — Desktop Flagship
hero.caption: Clinical sophistication balancing medical precision with luxury wellness.

challenge.title: Advanced anti-aging science requiring accessible consumer trust
challenge.lead: DeAge delivers advanced aesthetic dermatology, longevity treatments, and clinical skincare. High-ticket clinical procedures require immense patient trust, which their previous presence struggled to convey.
points: Patients felt intimidated by technical medical jargon without clear explanations of treatment expectations and downtime.
No clear distinction between in-clinic medical procedures and home-care clinical skincare formulations.
High first-contact drop-off due to an ambiguous consultation booking process.
challenge.objective: Create an authoritative, luxurious digital presence that articulates advanced dermatological science clearly and drives qualified consultation bookings.

strategy.title: Clinical authority paired with luxury aesthetic clarity
strategy.lead: We developed an editorial clinical visual system that explains anti-aging treatments transparently, showcases medical qualifications, and provides intuitive booking funnels.
principles: Minimalist, clinical-luxury design language inspired by modern dermatological institutes
Treatment transparency detailing procedure steps, candidate suitability, and recovery time
Bifurcated funnel distinguishing in-clinic clinical consultations from curated home formulations
Direct consultation calendar and WhatsApp inquiry pathways

decisions.title: Procedure expectation cards with recovery transparency
decisions.body: Each clinical service page includes structured expectation panels detailing procedure duration, sensation, downtime, and expected results timeline.
decisions.why: Demystifying the clinical experience removes anxiety and pre-qualifies patients before consultation calls.

decisions.title: Physician credentials and clinical technology showcase
decisions.body: Spotlighted US-FDA-cleared technologies, sterile clinical protocols, and specialist medical leadership.
decisions.why: In aesthetic medicine, patient confidence hinges entirely on proven medical authority and technology safety.

decisions.title: Integrated clinical skincare e-commerce path
decisions.body: Designed a dedicated Shopify-powered catalog for physician-curated skincare products alongside clinic services.
decisions.why: Creates post-treatment skincare regimen continuity and opens scalable direct product revenue.

designSystem.title: Precision dermatological system
designSystem.lead: Modern monochrome clinical foundation accented with refined metallic undertones.

items.v: Clean architectural sans-serif with refined micro-copy styling
Crisp clinical white, deep slate charcoal, and subtle platinum highlights
Structured grid alignments reflecting scientific precision
Natural skin textures, authentic clinic environments, and clean technology details

implementation.title: Figma to Shopify & Web engineering
implementation.lead: Iterative Figma design system transitioned into a custom responsive frontend with fast load performance.
points: Complete end-to-end Figma UI component library with dark/light clinical states
Custom Shopify theme integration powering both service inquiry and product checkout
Direct consultation routing into the clinic reception booking workflow
Fast sub-2 second mobile performance across 4G and broadband connections

projects.resultsNote: Deployed with custom consultation routing and physician-curated formulation e-commerce capabilities.
projects.takeaway: In high-end aesthetics and anti-aging, clarity is the greatest luxury. Giving patients transparent facts on procedures and downtime removes hesitation faster than glossy lifestyle imagery alone.

projects.headline: Authoritative Digital Presence for Premier Chartered Accountants
projects.statement: A modern, high-credibility corporate website reflecting institutional rigour, tax advisory expertise, and regulatory compliance for an established Mumbai CA firm.

card.blurb: Corporate authority and clear service architecture for an established Chartered Accountancy practice.
card.quote: The new website perfectly captures the professionalism and credibility our accounting firm needs. Kajal delivered a modern, fast, and highly authoritative corporate presence.
card.cite: Shubham Agrawal, Chartered Accountant @ MKPS & Associates LLP

hero.label: MKPS Corporate Portal — Desktop View
hero.caption: Corporate authority and structured financial advisory practice areas.

challenge.title: Decades of institutional trust masked by an outdated web presence
challenge.lead: MKPS & Associates LLP serves multinational corporations, growing enterprises, and HNIs in statutory audit, corporate taxation, and financial compliance. However, their digital footprint failed to match their industry standing.
points: Complex multidisciplinary services (Audit, Direct Tax, GST, Corporate Law, Valuation) were tangled into single dense text pages.
Prospective corporate clients could not quickly locate partner credentials, firm affiliations, or industry experience.
Lacked responsive design, creating a poor first impression when accessed by corporate decision-makers on mobile devices.
challenge.objective: Design and deploy a distinguished, responsive corporate web presence in Figma and Wix that establishes institutional authority and facilitates corporate inquiries.

strategy.title: Clarity, regulatory gravity, and partner authority
strategy.lead: We structured the firm’s digital presence around practice area expertise, sector specializations, and clear corporate engagement pathways.
principles: Classic corporate navy and crisp white palette conveying stability and financial trust
Structured practice area hubs with regulatory scope and advisory solutions
Partner profile directory highlighting professional credentials, ICAI affiliations, and experience
Secure corporate consultation inquiry channel with preliminary engagement brief

decisions.title: Categorized practice area architecture
decisions.body: Reorganized 15+ specialized services into 4 core pillars: Audit & Assurance, Direct & Indirect Taxation, Corporate Advisory, and Regulatory Compliance.
decisions.why: Corporate CFOs and directors find relevant expertise within seconds without wading through general accounting copy.

decisions.title: Partner credentials and firm governance showcase
decisions.body: Developed dedicated partner profiles detailing leadership experience, certifications, and sector track records.
decisions.why: In professional services, clients hire trusted advisors. Leading with partner profiles establishes human credibility.

decisions.title: Corporate engagement inquiry brief
decisions.body: Replaced vague generic forms with a structured corporate intake requesting organization type, service requirement, and timeline.
decisions.why: Filters spam and delivers actionable context to the firm’s engagement partners immediately.

designSystem.title: Financial institutional system
designSystem.lead: A commanding corporate design system reflecting stability, precision, and confidentiality.

items.v: Authoritative serif titles paired with crisp neutral corporate body type
Deep midnight navy, sharp slate grey, and crisp white surfaces
Balanced corporate proportions with structured divider lines
Subtle document hover states and smooth corporate section tabs

implementation.title: Figma to Wix corporate engineering
implementation.lead: Iterated through comprehensive Figma design prototypes before production build on Wix Studio with full responsive precision.
points: Figma UI library with complete breakpoint wireframes for desktop, laptop, tablet, and mobile
Clean, accessible Wix Studio implementation adhering to strict regulatory professional norms
Automated corporate contact routing into designated practice lead inboxes
Fast page load times with crisp vector typography and optimized corporate assets

projects.resultsNote: Deployed on production domain with validated corporate inquiry routing and partner directory verification.
projects.takeaway: For professional financial services, digital authority is built on clarity and structure. Organizing complex practice areas into logical corporate pillars transformed how prospective corporate clients engage.

projects.headline: Enterprise IT Architecture & Service Navigation for Global Tech Solutions
projects.statement: A modern, high-performance web experience positioning a Bangalore software services provider for enterprise IT contracts and technology partnerships.

card.blurb: Enterprise software architecture and intuitive capability navigation for a Bangalore IT solutions provider.
card.quote: Kajal and her team took our complex enterprise IT service offerings and structured them into an intuitive, high-converting digital presence. Our client inquiries have increased significantly since the launch.

hero.label: Shap Infotech Enterprise Portal — Desktop
hero.caption: Modern technology capability matrices and streamlined enterprise inquiry routing.

challenge.title: Sophisticated technical capabilities obscured by generic software messaging
challenge.lead: Shap Infotech provides enterprise cloud migration, bespoke software development, and digital transformation consulting. Their existing website sounded generic and failed to articulate specific technology capabilities to enterprise CTOs.
points: Technical capabilities across cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and custom development were grouped without clear delivery frameworks.
Enterprise decision-makers could not easily evaluate tech stacks, engagement models, or past case studies.
The mobile browsing experience suffered from text-heavy pages and slow loading performance.
challenge.objective: Redesign and develop a sharp, modern B2B technology website in Figma and WordPress that articulates engineering maturity and captures enterprise RFP leads.

strategy.title: Engineering maturity meets modular capability discovery
strategy.lead: We architected a technology matrix highlighting proven tech stacks, agile delivery methodologies, and clear engagement tiers (Dedicated Teams, Project Basis, Managed Services).
principles: Modern dark/light tech aesthetic featuring high-tech indigo accents and clean line geometry
Modular capability hubs mapping services directly to enterprise business outcomes
Technology stack filters showcasing proficiencies (AWS, React, Node, Python, Docker)
Enterprise RFP intake flow capturing project scope, budget range, and timeline

decisions.title: Technology stack matrix with proficiency indicators
decisions.body: Built an interactive capabilities grid showcasing frameworks, cloud environments, and databases deployed across projects.
decisions.why: Engineering leaders vetting agency partners look for immediate proof of specific stack proficiency.

decisions.title: Transparent engagement model framework
decisions.body: Created dedicated breakdowns explaining Dedicated Teams, Fixed Price SOWs, and Staff Augmentation models.
decisions.why: Clarifies commercial working structures upfront and shortens the sales discovery cycle.

decisions.title: Technical inquiry brief with file upload capabilities
decisions.body: Replaced single-line contact forms with an RFP workflow allowing prospective clients to submit requirement documents.
decisions.why: Delivers qualified briefs directly to the solution architecture team for faster turnaround on technical proposals.

designSystem.title: Modern B2B enterprise system
designSystem.lead: Clean architectural layouts designed to reflect engineering precision and digital scalability.

items.v: Technical geometric sans-serif for headings and readable monospace accents
Deep tech obsidian, crisp white surfaces, and vibrant electric violet highlights
Modular capability cards, tech badges, process timeline steppers
Clean schematic system diagrams and abstract technology vectors

implementation.title: Figma prototypes into custom WordPress build
implementation.lead: Designed in Figma with reusable components and coded as a fast, maintainable WordPress installation.
points: Custom modular Gutenberg blocks allowing the marketing team to deploy new service pages quickly
Optimized core web vitals achieving sub-1.8s load times across global testing nodes
Secure RFP form handling with automated email notifications to sales and technical directors
Fully responsive design verified across mobile, tablet, and ultra-wide desktop monitors

projects.resultsNote: Deployed with interactive tech stack matrices and enterprise inquiry routing.
projects.takeaway: Enterprise software buyers value technical specificity over marketing hyperbole. Presenting exact capabilities, frameworks, and engagement models converted casual website visits into qualified RFP conversations.

projects.headline: Patient-Centric Healthcare Experience & Multi-Specialty Inquiries
projects.statement: A compassionate, reassuring digital experience for a comprehensive Bangalore diagnostic and outpatient healthcare network, simplifying appointment booking across specialties.

card.blurb: Compassionate patient-first healthcare architecture and doctor directory for a Bangalore diagnostic network.

hero.label: Swastha Healthcare Portal — Desktop & Mobile
hero.caption: Clear specialty routing and streamlined doctor consultation booking.

challenge.title: Healthcare navigation friction during critical patient moments
challenge.lead: Swastha Healthcare provides multi-specialty outpatient clinics, diagnostic pathology, and preventative health checks. Patients seeking care were frustrated by confusing menus, missing doctor schedules, and broken booking forms.
points: Patients faced difficulty finding which doctors operated at which clinical branch location.
Pathology test lists lacked transparent preparation instructions (fasting requirements, report timelines).
Mobile visitors—often searching in urgent need—struggled with slow loading speeds and cramped click targets.
challenge.objective: Redesign and engineer an accessible, patient-friendly website in Figma and WordPress that makes finding specialists and booking consultations immediate and effortless.

strategy.title: Compassionate clarity and branch-level precision
strategy.lead: We rebuilt the user journey around the patient’s primary question: "Which specialist can treat my symptom at my nearest clinic today?"
principles: Reassuring clinical aesthetics with high visual contrast and accessible font sizing
Specialist directory filterable by medical department, branch location, and available days
Diagnostic test guide with transparent preparation instructions and online home-collection requests
Emergency direct-call triggers and one-tap WhatsApp appointment booking

decisions.title: Filterable specialist doctor directory
decisions.body: Built an intuitive doctor directory where patients can search by symptom, department (Cardiology, Pediatrics, Orthopedics), or clinic branch.
decisions.why: Reduces time-to-appointment and gives patients confidence in doctor qualifications and visiting hours.

decisions.title: Diagnostic test preparation guides
decisions.body: Each diagnostic test card details test requirements, fasting protocols, and turn-around time for digital report delivery.
decisions.why: Eliminates patient confusion and reduces repetitive calls to the front-desk reception.

decisions.title: Mobile-first persistent appointment action bar
decisions.body: Implemented a fixed bottom mobile bar with Book Appointment, Call Clinic, and Request Home Sample Collection.
decisions.why: Ensures patients can take immediate action on any page without scrolling back to menus.

designSystem.title: Accessible healthcare system
designSystem.lead: WCAG-conscious design system emphasizing comfort, visual clarity, and calm reassuring tones.

items.v: Highly legible humanist sans-serif with accessible line spacing
Soothing clinical cyan, comforting medical teal, warm neutral canvas
High-contrast buttons, generous touch targets, and large readable type
Clean medical line icons representing departments and health packages

implementation.title: Figma and custom WordPress deployment
implementation.lead: Developed responsive Figma wireframes tested against patient scenarios, built out as a custom WordPress theme.
points: Custom post types for Doctors, Departments, Branch Locations, and Diagnostic Tests
Appointment booking forms connected directly to branch desk WhatsApp and email systems
Fast page delivery compliant with Core Web Vitals to assist patients on mobile connections
Zero bloated plugins to ensure rock-solid uptime and security

projects.resultsNote: Deployed with branch-level doctor directories and diagnostic package booking paths.
projects.takeaway: In healthcare digital design, empathy is ergonomics. Removing clutter and making doctor schedules, branch details, and booking actions immediately visible brings comfort to patients when they need it most.

projects.headline: UK E-Commerce Paid Acquisition & Creative Funnel Restructuring
projects.statement: Transforming paid social performance for a premium UK outdoor furniture retailer through segmented Meta Ads campaigns, dynamic catalog feeds, and high-converting landing experiences.

card.blurb: Multi-stage Meta Ads funnels, creative testing, and ROAS-focused campaign restructuring for a UK luxury furniture retailer.
card.quote: Kajal & Co. completely transformed our online presence and acquisition strategy. From scaling our Meta Ads profitably to ranking us organically across the UK, their data-driven approach delivered exceptional results.

meta.v: Scale UK outdoor living sales & optimize acquisition efficiency

hero.label: Meta Ads Campaign Architecture — Blythe Living
hero.caption: Full-funnel audience segmentation and creative rotation across UK markets.

challenge.title: High-ticket seasonal furniture struggling with ad fatigue and broad targeting
challenge.lead: Blythe Living offers premium garden sets, pergolas, and outdoor loungers. Outdoor furniture in the UK is heavily seasonal and carries a high average order value, making generic ad strategies inefficient.
points: Previous campaigns relied on single broad audiences without segmenting first-time buyers from warm catalog visitors.
Ad creative suffered from rapid fatigue, running single product images without showing lifestyle garden context or material durability.
High cart abandonment on mobile due to lack of trust badging and financing visibility.
challenge.objective: Restructure Meta Ads into a disciplined multi-stage acquisition and retargeting engine that drives profitable outdoor living sales across the UK.
symptoms: Previous campaigns relied on single broad audiences without segmenting first-time buyers from warm catalog visitors.
Ad creative suffered from rapid fatigue, running single product images without showing lifestyle garden context or material durability.
High cart abandonment on mobile due to lack of trust badging and financing visibility.

campaign.title: Full-funnel segmentation and seasonal creative sprints
campaign.lead: We rebuilt the advertising account from the ground up, isolating cold prospecting from mid-funnel consideration and dynamic product retargeting.
campaign.audience: UK homeowners aged 30–65 interested in garden design, home renovation, and premium outdoor living
campaign.offer: Curated seasonal garden sets with free UK mainland delivery and 5-year weather-resistant warranty
campaign.creative: UGC lifestyle styling clips, carousel feature showcases, and weather-durability demonstrations

funnel.body: Broad lifestyle video ads showcasing premium garden transformations and weatherproofing.
Carousel ads highlighting specific outdoor collections with customer reviews and dimensions.
DPA catalog ads displaying viewed products paired with delivery guarantees and warranty trust.
Collection-matched Shopify landing pages featuring finance options and fast checkout.

execution.title: Disciplined account consolidation
execution.body: Consolidated fragmented ad sets into structured testing and scaling campaigns to feed Meta’s algorithm maximum conversion data.

execution.title: Weekly creative sprint framework
execution.body: Implemented a continuous testing schedule rotating static lifestyle imagery, customer unboxing videos, and dimension overlays.

execution.title: Dynamic product ads (DPA) feed optimization
execution.body: Cleaned the Shopify product feed to include enriched collection tags, custom image overlays, and live inventory status.

execution.title: Landing page conversion alignment
execution.body: Aligned ad messaging directly with product detail headlines, highlighting UK mainland delivery and weather protection.

optimisations.decision: Separated garden dining sets from lounge furniture in prospecting
optimisations.reason: Dining and lounging buyers have distinct room dimensions and price tolerances.
optimisations.outcome: Higher engagement relevance and reduced wasted impressions on mismatched collections.

optimisations.decision: Introduced UGC and customer patio transformation videos
optimisations.reason: Studio product packshots failed to answer how furniture looks in authentic British gardens.
optimisations.outcome: Click-through rates improved across cold interest segments.

optimisations.decision: Added Klarna and payment installment badges to retargeting creative
optimisations.reason: High purchase price caused hesitation at final checkout steps.
optimisations.outcome: Lower cart drop-off and faster buying decisions on dynamic retargeting ads.

businessResult.title: A sustainable acquisition engine for UK home living
businessResult.lead: The restructured Meta Ads funnel established a predictable acquisition pipeline that capitalized on seasonal demand spikes while maintaining efficiency.
points: Eliminated ad set cannibalization by establishing clean audience exclusions between cold, warm, and hot segments.
Established an agile creative pipeline that refreshed assets before frequency fatigue set in.

projects.resultsNote: Managed continuously across four seasonal quarters with dedicated creative rotation and catalog feed optimization.
projects.takeaway: In high-ticket home and garden retail, ad creative must sell the lifestyle transformation before the product specs. Pairing authentic lifestyle creative with disciplined catalog retargeting created a robust acquisition system.

projects.headline: High-Intent Local Lead Generation & WhatsApp Funnels for Relocation Services
projects.statement: Deploying hyper-local Meta lead generation campaigns and direct WhatsApp inquiry funnels for a prominent Delhi NCR relocation and cargo provider.

card.blurb: Geo-targeted Meta Ads and direct WhatsApp inquiry funnels capturing high-intent relocation leads in Delhi NCR.

meta.v: Generate qualified residential and commercial moving inquiries

hero.label: Hyper-Local Moving Funnel — Delhi NCR
hero.caption: Geo-targeted residential and office shifting campaigns with instant quote forms.

challenge.title: High competition and low lead quality in local relocation services
challenge.lead: The logistics and domestic moving sector in Delhi NCR is crowded with unorganized players. M.D. Cargo needed to differentiate its professional packing standards while capturing customers actively planning a relocation.
points: Previous lead campaigns received incomplete phone numbers and low-intent price shoppers.
Relocation needs are urgent; delays in responding to inquiries resulted in lost business to competitors.
Ad creative looked generic and failed to highlight safety, insurance, and professional multi-layer packing.
challenge.objective: Build a targeted local lead generation framework on Meta that filters low-intent inquiries and connects qualified leads directly with moving coordinators via WhatsApp and Instant Forms.
symptoms: Previous lead campaigns received incomplete phone numbers and low-intent price shoppers.
Relocation needs are urgent; delays in responding to inquiries resulted in lost business to competitors.
Ad creative looked generic and failed to highlight safety, insurance, and professional multi-layer packing.

campaign.title: Radius targeting, professional proof, and instant WhatsApp routing
campaign.lead: We structured ad sets targeting high-movement residential zones and corporate tech corridors, leading with verified packing footage and immediate moving cost estimates.
campaign.audience: Delhi, Gurgaon, and Noida residents aged 25–55 within high-density residential and corporate moving clusters
campaign.offer: Free on-site or video survey, zero-damage multi-layer packing guarantee, and transparent transit insurance
campaign.creative: Time-lapse packing demonstrations, vehicle fleet trust imagery, and clear moving checklists

funnel.body: Highlight stress-free moving with professional multi-layer bubble and corrugated packing.
Instant Lead Form asking moving origin, destination city, home size (1BHK/2BHK/3BHK), and expected shifting date.
Automated WhatsApp message sent immediately with estimated price band and coordinator contact.
Moving coordinator conducts swift video or on-site inventory check.

execution.title: Geographic and residential cluster targeting
execution.body: Targeted high-mobility sub-regions in Gurgaon, Noida, and South Delhi, prioritizing residents likely to relocate.

execution.title: Structured lead qualification fields
execution.body: Customized Instant Forms to require move size (BHK) and shifting timeframe, automatically filtering unqualified submissions.

execution.title: Direct Click-to-WhatsApp ad variants
execution.body: Tested Click-to-WhatsApp ads for urgent same-week shifting requirements, connecting leads to dispatch teams within seconds.

execution.title: Authentic fleet and packing creative
execution.body: Replaced stock photos with genuine photos of M.D. Cargo branded trucks and trained packing crews at work.

optimisations.decision: Made move date a mandatory qualifying dropdown
optimisations.reason: Eliminated inquiries looking for moves 6 months away, prioritizing active 14-day booking cycles.
optimisations.outcome: Lead-to-booking conversion rate improved dramatically for the dispatch team.

optimisations.decision: Separated office/commercial moves from household shifting
optimisations.reason: Office shifting requires specialized equipment and carries much higher contract value.
optimisations.outcome: Generated dedicated commercial relocation briefs without confusing household movers.

optimisations.decision: Swapped single image ads for video packing clips
optimisations.reason: Demonstrating protective packing of fragile electronics and crockery answered primary customer fears.
optimisations.outcome: Higher form completion rate with improved trust signals.

businessResult.title: A reliable relocation inquiry pipeline
businessResult.lead: The optimized lead system delivered steady, qualified moving inquiries week after week, allowing the dispatch team to schedule moves efficiently.
points: Filtered out spam submissions through structured form questions and WhatsApp verification.
Established consistent operational booking volume across key Delhi, Gurgaon, and Noida service zones.

projects.resultsNote: Deployed with structured Instant Lead Forms and direct WhatsApp dispatch integration.
projects.takeaway: In local service businesses where trust and timing are everything, asking one or two qualifying questions inside the ad form filters out low-intent noise and arms the sales team for an immediate close.

projects.headline: High-Intent Real Estate Lead Generation & HNI Acquisition Funnels
projects.statement: Precision Meta Ads targeting, luxury property showcases, and structured pre-qualification funnels for a high-growth real estate consultancy in Gurgaon.

card.blurb: Targeted HNI lead generation and qualification funnels for premium real estate investments in NCR.

meta.v: Generate verified inquiries for premium residential & commercial projects

hero.label: Luxury Real Estate Acquisition — Delhi NCR
hero.caption: High-net-worth property acquisition funnels with automated qualification.

challenge.title: High real estate ad spend wasted on invalid numbers and unqualified inquiries
challenge.lead: Selling premium and luxury real estate in competitive markets like Gurgaon often results in ad campaigns swamped by brokers, job seekers, and unverified contacts.
points: Previous lead campaigns suffered from low connection rates due to autofilled inaccurate contact numbers.
Inquiries lacked budget alignment, inquiring about multi-crore properties without financial capability.
Ad creative felt like generic architectural renders without highlighting location advantages or developer credentials.
challenge.objective: Design a high-precision Meta performance marketing campaign that attracts genuine HNI buyers, pre-qualifies investment budgets, and delivers verified leads to property consultants.
symptoms: Previous lead campaigns suffered from low connection rates due to autofilled inaccurate contact numbers.
Inquiries lacked budget alignment, inquiring about multi-crore properties without financial capability.
Ad creative felt like generic architectural renders without highlighting location advantages or developer credentials.

campaign.title: HNI targeting, verified qualification, and bespoke site visit funnels
campaign.lead: We structured ad sets around high-value affinity audiences, combining high-resolution project walkthroughs with explicit budget qualification steps in the lead form.
campaign.audience: Affluent professionals, corporate executives, and investors aged 32–60 interested in luxury properties in Delhi NCR
campaign.offer: Exclusive pre-launch pricing, private site walkthroughs, and guaranteed flexible payment plans
campaign.creative: Architectural video tours, floor plan blueprints, and infrastructure connectivity maps (Dwarka Expressway, Golf Course Extension)
channels: Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram Feed, Stories, Reels)

funnel.body: Video walkthrough highlighting luxury amenities, clubhouse features, and strategic location connectivity.
Lead Form with manual phone number entry and mandatory investment budget selection.
Instant delivery of detailed floor plans and pricing sheets via WhatsApp.
Senior relationship manager schedules private on-site inspection tour.

execution.title: Precision demographic and interest layering
execution.body: Layered frequent international travelers, luxury vehicle owners, and business leadership titles with real estate investment behaviors.

execution.title: Higher Intent Form configuration
